## Checklist

- [ ] One file per port in `ports/<slug>.yml`
- [ ] `npm run build` run, regenerated `README.md` and `data/ports.json` committed
- [ ] `download_url` points to the creator's own release page (no rehosted files)
- [ ] `version` / `version_date` match the latest release
- [ ] Screenshots (if any) are in `images/<slug>/` with `credit` and `source_url`
